title: Custody collection — historical Phase I terminals and current durable obligations
note: This collection preserves the historical Phase-I custody terminals and may also carry explicit outside-phase obligations. An outside-phase custody is durable queued responsibility; it does not reopen Phase I and it does not imply an active work lease. Historical record. Phase I closed on 2026-08-27 as CLOSED_INCOMPLETE / NOT_EARNED. A terminal on a custody ends the old assignment; held_by then records who carried it historically. Surviving work is reissued only through the terminal successor addresses below. Hierarchical on purpose. An earlier draft of this file held ten flat peers and mixed abstraction levels - exit obligations, service work, coordination cleanup, and a future product capability - which reproduces at a new layer the failure it was built to fix. The five EXIT custodies mirror the five clauses of the Phase-I exit exactly. Every DELIVERY custody names the exit custody it serves, or is marked explicitly outside the phase exit with a reason. If an initiative cannot name the exit custody it serves, it is not Phase-I work. Every one collects work that already exists; none proposes an initiative nobody has started.
